$comment: An example profile for a second domain: lithium-ion battery cathode materials. It declares no paper-level group: in a cathode paper the precursor, the synthesis route and the test protocol vary per sample or are stated for the whole series, and a whole-series value is carried by applies_to_all_samples rather than by a paper-level record. Copy this file to start a new domain; README has the walkthrough.
name: battery_cathode
description_zh: 锂离子电池正极材料（层状氧化物、尖晶石、橄榄石等）：成分与合成条件、颗粒形貌，以及比容量、倍率、电压与循环保持率。

prompt.domain_subject: lithium-ion battery cathode materials (layered oxides such as NCM, NCA or LiCoO2, spinel LiMn2O4, olivine LiFePO4, Li-rich layered oxides)
prompt.sample_definition: A sample is a cathode active material that this paper synthesises or modifies itself and tests. The anode, the electrolyte, the separator, the conductive carbon and binder, the current collector and a whole full cell are never samples, nor is a commercial cathode powder the paper only buys and uses as a reference. Changes to the cathode material itself make separate samples: each composition or dopant level, each calcination temperature or time, each surface coating and each synthesis route is its own sample. The same powder merely tested at a second C-rate, in a second voltage window or at a second temperature is the same sample.
prompt.field_scope: Every field describes the cathode active material, its synthesis, or its electrochemical performance. A value that belongs to another component (the anode, the electrolyte, a conductive additive, the current collector) or to a commercial reference material the paper does not make is not a value of this field, however well its name fits: leave it out.
prompt.sample_examples: (e.g. one per dopant level, per calcination temperature, per surface coating)
prompt.condition_examples: (composition, dopant level, calcination temperature and time, atmosphere, coating...)
prompt.no_samples_clause: the paper makes no cathode material of its own
prompt.no_samples_condition: the paper synthesises or modifies no cathode material of its own (it only tests a commercial cathode powder, or studies only the anode or the electrolyte, say)
prompt.samples_present_condition: such a cathode material is made
prompt.subset_examples: "all samples calcined at 800 °C", "the coated samples", "the doped cathodes"
prompt.partial_collective_example: "the doped samples", when one listed sample is the undoped pristine material
prompt.multi_condition_example: discharge capacity at 0.1 C and at 1 C
prompt.matching_justification_example: both are the 1 mol% Al-doped sample

ui.no_samples_message_zh: 该论文没有自己制备的正极材料，所以没有样品级数据。

fields.name: cathode_composition
fields.label: 正极成分
fields.description: Chemical composition of the cathode active material as the paper writes it, including any dopant, e.g. 'LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2', 'Li1.2Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2', 'LiFePO4/C'.
fields.description_zh: 正极活性材料的化学组成（含掺杂元素）。

fields.name: synthesis_method
fields.label: 合成方法
fields.description: Route by which the cathode material was synthesised.

fields.name: calcination_temperature
fields.label: 煅烧温度
fields.description: Temperature of the final calcination (sintering, lithiation) of the cathode material (°C) -- not a precursor drying step or an electrode drying temperature.
fields.description_zh: 最终煅烧（烧结、锂化）温度（°C）。

fields.name: calcination_time
fields.label: 煅烧时间
fields.description: Duration of the final calcination of the cathode material (min).

fields.name: coating_material
fields.label: 包覆材料
fields.description: Material of a surface coating applied to the cathode particles, e.g. 'Al2O3', 'Li3PO4'; 'none' only when the paper says the sample is uncoated.
fields.description_zh: 正极颗粒表面包覆层的材料。

fields.name: particle_size
fields.label: 粒径
fields.description: Mean or median (D50) size of the cathode particles (nm). When the paper gives both, the secondary (agglomerate) particle size.
fields.description_zh: 正极颗粒的平均粒径或 D50（二次颗粒优先）。
fields.condition_hint: primary or secondary particle, e.g. 'D50 of secondary particles'

fields.name: initial_discharge_capacity
fields.label: 首次放电比容量
fields.description: Specific discharge capacity of the first (or first stable) cycle, per gram of active material (mAh/g).
fields.description_zh: 首次放电比容量（mAh/g）；测试倍率见条件。
fields.condition_hint: C-rate or current density, e.g. '0.1 C' or '20 mA g-1'
fields.condition_rule: the C-rate or current density it was measured at
fields.missing_condition_note_zh: 原文提取结果未注明首次放电比容量的测试倍率

fields.name: high_rate_capacity
fields.label: 高倍率比容量
fields.description: Specific discharge capacity at the highest C-rate of the rate-capability test (mAh/g).
fields.description_zh: 倍率测试中最高倍率下的放电比容量（mAh/g）。
fields.condition_rule: the C-rate it was measured at
fields.missing_condition_note_zh: 原文提取结果未注明高倍率比容量对应的倍率

fields.name: max_c_rate
fields.label: 最高测试倍率
fields.description: Highest C-rate reached in the rate-capability test (C).
fields.description_zh: 倍率测试达到的最高倍率（C）。

fields.name: upper_cutoff_voltage
fields.label: 充电截止电压
fields.description: Upper cut-off voltage of the galvanostatic cycling window vs. Li/Li+ (V): 4.3 for a '2.8-4.3 V' window. Quote the upper limit only, not the window.
fields.description_zh: 恒流充放电窗口的上限截止电压（V，相对 Li/Li+）。

fields.name: average_discharge_voltage
fields.label: 平均放电电压
fields.description: Average (mid-point) discharge voltage of the cathode vs. Li/Li+ (V).

fields.name: cycle_number
fields.label: 循环圈数
fields.description: Number of charge-discharge cycles of the long-term cycling test the capacity retention is reported after.
fields.description_zh: 长循环测试的圈数（报告容量保持率时的循环次数）。

fields.name: capacity_retention
fields.label: 容量保持率
fields.description: Capacity retention at the end of the long-term cycling test (%), relative to the initial capacity.
fields.description_zh: 长循环后的容量保持率，数值 90 表示 90%；循环圈数和倍率见条件。
fields.condition_hint: cycles and C-rate, e.g. 'after 100 cycles at 1 C'
fields.condition_rule: the number of cycles and the C-rate
fields.missing_condition_note_zh: 原文提取结果未注明容量保持率对应的循环圈数和倍率
